definition: Unified student information from the three university examples
encoding_detail: Master, plan, reference or relationship/index data; this table does not directly produce an event in the current ES. Related objects can still have logs from other tables.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE student (student_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, date_of_birth TEXT NOT NULL, phone_number TEXT NOT NULL, home_address TEXT NOT NULL, registration_eligibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(registration_eligibility IN ('ELIGIBLE','INELIGIBLE')), class TEXT NOT NULL, major TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (student_id))

definition: Every recorded grading action, including regrading
encoding_detail: One grading occurrence per composite-key row.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE assignment_grading (assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL, instructor_id TEXT NOT NULL, grading_time TEXT NOT NULL, score INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(score BETWEEN 0 AND 100), evaluation TEXT NOT NULL, grading_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ORIGINAL' CHECK(grading_kind IN ('ORIGINAL','REASSESSMENT')), reassessment_event_id TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (assignment_id,instructor_id,grading_time), FOREIGN KEY (assignment_id) REFERENCES assignment(assignment_id), FOREIGN KEY (instructor_id) REFERENCES instructor(instructor_id))
